title: Arbitrary high order shaped stencils for time domain finite difference schemes in seismic wave propagation
summary: Finite Difference Schemes are widely used in the approximation of different hyperbolic (wave-like) differential equations, and are particularly important for seismic wave modelling and its applications. Classical methods based on Taylor Series are dominant in the literature; however, it is known that these methods can suffer from excessive numerical dispersion.
